caption: Psalm 22 says the sufferer is ‘poured out like water.’ It does not predict blood and water flowing from a spear wound in Jesus’s side.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict blood and water? The psalmist says, ‘I am poured out like water.’ John says blood and water flowed from Jesus’s pierced side.
slides.body: The psalmist says, ‘I am poured out like water.’ John says blood and water flowed from Jesus’s pierced side.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict blood and water?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 22:14: I am poured out like water … My heart is like wax.
slides.body: I am poured out like water … My heart is like wax.
slides.heading: Ps 22:14

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 19:34, BSB: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
slides.body: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Jn 19:34

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The shared image is striking Psalm 22 is strongly linked with Jesus’s death, so its water language can bring John’s scene to mind.
slides.body: Psalm 22 is strongly linked with Jesus’s death, so its water language can bring John’s scene to mind.
slides.heading: The shared image is striking

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But the detail is not in the verse The sufferer is like poured-out water. The verse says nothing about blood, a spear or a wound in his side.
slides.body: The sufferer is like poured-out water. The verse says nothing about blood, a spear or a wound in his side.
slides.heading: But the detail is not in the verse

title: Poured out like water
